name: Guyana

fees.name: Visitor visa on arrival (standard)
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a visa; pre-approval letter must be obtained before travel (visa affixed on arrival)
fees.notes: Approval letter required before boarding; apply via Ministry of Home Affairs eServices portal (eservices.iss.gov.gy), processing 10-14 working days per Embassy of Guyana Brussels.

fees.name: Visitor visa on arrival (expedited)
fees.notes: Expedited processing of the visa-on-arrival approval.

fees.name: Tourist visa (embassy-issued, single entry)
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a visa applying at a Guyana mission
fees.notes: Fees are set per mission in local currency (e.g. High Commission New Delhi charges INR 5,000 single-entry tourist). No universal USD schedule published; see reciprocity_variations.

fees.name: Business visa (embassy-issued)
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a visa; must apply online via Ministry of Home Affairs eServices
fees.notes: Per-mission local-currency fees (e.g. New Delhi: INR 7,000 single entry, INR 10,000 multiple entry). No universal USD schedule verified.

reciprocity_variations.note: Single-entry tourist visa fee at the Guyana High Commission, New Delhi (non-refundable).
Single-entry business visa at Guyana High Commission New Delhi; multiple entry INR 10,000.

free_visa_notes: Guyana grants visa-free entry to nationals of most countries, including USA, GBR, CAN, EU members, CARICOM and most Commonwealth states - no fee applies for them. Fees above apply only to the minority of nationalities (e.g. IND, CHN, NGA, PAK, BGD) that require a visa.
